name: Ming Yue Zhao Jing Ze
overview: Xiang Ming Yue, a minor actor with only 108 credits, suddenly transmigrates into a short drama as the evil female supporting character who shares her name! She must live through the entire life of the villainous character—her schemes exposed and a tragic death awaited—before she can return to the real world. Determined to commit mischief, she doesn’t realize that the seemingly cold and sharp-tongued male lead, Song Jing Ze, has long harbored feelings for her. As the original female lead is forced to turn dark, the plot spirals out of control. Xiang Ming Yue faces a crucial choice: where should she go from here?
